evidence.field: 字形; 說文; 形義通解
evidence.text: The 昨 entry displays a Small Seal form and a Warring States manuscript form, but no oracle-bone or bronze examples in its form section. It reports the Shuowen analysis 从日、乍聲 and the gloss 壘日也; its modern explanation says 昨 means the day before today and more broadly the past. This supports the received component analysis, but does not establish a pre-Qin graphic history or explain how 壘日 relates semantically to ‘yesterday’.
evidence.title: 漢語多功能字庫 - 字頭「昨」

evidence.field: 形義通解; dated textual citations
evidence.text: The entry cites 昨暮夜 in the Shiji 外戚世家 for the ‘yesterday’ sense, another example from 世說新語, and 東晉 Tao Yuanming’s 覺今是而昨非 and a Tang poem for the wider past sense. These attestations show use in those texts but the page does not date the earliest occurrence of the graph or word; a transmitted text citation alone does not establish first-attestation chronology.
evidence.title: 漢語多功能字庫 - 字頭「昨」

evidence.field: 形義通解; 甲骨文、金文、簡帛文字; 說文
evidence.text: The 乍 entry reports a proposed oracle-bone depiction of cutting vegetation with a blade, citing 吴其昌 and 裘錫圭, and interprets its early sense as clearing vegetation. It separately records early uses glossed as building, casting, and related actions, later meanings such as ‘suddenly/temporarily’, and Shuowen’s different analysis 从亡从一 with gloss 止也/亡也. This is a competing account of 乍’s own graphic origin and lexical development; it does not undermine the explicit phonetic analysis of 乍 in 昨. The depicted object’s name and pronunciation are not independently established here.
evidence.title: 漢語多功能字庫 - 字頭「乍」

evidence.field: 普通話; 廣韻; 中古音 categories
evidence.text: The entry reports current Mandarin 昨 zuó and Guangyun fanqie 在各, with Middle Chinese categories 從母, 入聲, 宕攝, 唐/鐸, 開口一等. These records support a traditional sound reading but do not alone demonstrate the ancient sound relationship to 乍.
evidence.title: 漢語多功能字庫 - 字頭「昨」

evidence.field: 普通話; 廣韻; 中古音 categories
evidence.text: The entry reports current Mandarin 乍 zhà and Guangyun fanqie 鋤駕, with Middle Chinese categories 崇母, 去聲, 假攝, 麻/禡, 開口二等. The host and component therefore have different listed Middle Chinese rhyme and tone categories; these data should not be mistaken for same-system Old Chinese reconstructions.
evidence.title: 漢語多功能字庫 - 字頭「乍」

evidence.text: The supplied exact local row gives 乍 MC dzraeH and OC *[dz]ˤrak-s, gloss ‘suddenly’ (pinyin zhà). Compared within this same system to 昨 *[dz]ˤak, the forms share an onset and pharyngealized quality but differ in rhyme and final morphology. This is a pronunciation comparison, not independent proof of the phonetic role, which is instead explicitly asserted by Shuowen and the CUHK entry.

gaps: No securely dated earliest occurrence of 昨 was established. CUHK's Shiji, 世說新語, Eastern Jin, and Tang citations attest later uses in transmitted sources but do not date the first graphic or word use.
CUHK lists a Small Seal and Warring States manuscript example for 昨 but no oracle-bone or bronze examples. The consulted evidence does not establish earlier graphic changes or corruption.
The relationship between Shuowen 壘日 and ‘yesterday’ is not explained in the inspected evidence. Keep the historical gloss distinct from attested senses.

Shuowen and CUHK explicitly analyze 昨 as 日 semantic plus 乍 phonetic. 乍’s own graphic origin is disputed: CUHK gives a vegetation-cutting interpretation while also reporting the distinct Shuowen account; no evidence found that the source tool/object's name was pronounced like 昨. No whole-graph borrowing claim is established.
Official Unicode Unihan pages for both characters could not be opened. Local kMandarin rows were provided as input, not externally verified; they are current readings only.

Xiaoxuetang pages were opened but did not expose exact glyph records/images or the official CC0 notice in a way verifiable here. No Xiaoxuetang image selected. The exact Commons 乍 seal redraw is reusable only under its stated source permission terms, which require checking the linked agreement before reuse; no public-domain grant was asserted.

The official Baxter–Sagart supplementary table page was found, and exact local rows were supplied for both 昨 and 乍. The tool did not expose the exact PDF rows in the retrieved excerpt, so local row provenance remains task-supplied rather than independently extracted from the PDF.

items.caption: A modern redraw of the 乍 seal-script form referenced by Shuowen; it illustrates the phonetic component identified in the received analysis of 昨.
items.alt: Black seal-style strokes depicting 乍 on a plain background.
items.selection_reason: This exact file page identifies the graph as 乍 in Shuowen seal-script style and links its source. It can illustrate the component’s received seal form, but it does not document 昨’s ancient graphic history.

limitations.text: No image of 昨 itself selected: inspected character-specific evidence showed only a received seal example and Warring States manuscript form, while no suitably rights-verified direct 昨 asset was established in this search. The available 乍 redraw illustrates the component but cannot stand in for the whole graph’s history.
